newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: South African watchdog blocks cement merger.
newsitem.headline: South African watchdog blocks cement merger.

text.p: The competition board would recommend to Trade and Industry Minister Alec Erwin that the proposed merger between Anglo-Alpha Ltd and Murray and Roberts Holdings Ltd, owner of Blue Circle should not be allowed.
"After careful consideration of all the relevant facts and arguments it was decided to recommend to the minister that the merger should not be allowed," the board said in a statement on Friday.
Murray and Roberts and Anglo-Alpha proposed to merge their cement interests in June. The groups said the merger would increase competition by allowing them to gain important efficiencies.
The board said it was not convinced that the merger would be in the interests of the public.

"The Board concluded that with little prospect of new rivals entering the market as well as the negligible threat of imports, there were insufficient market pressures after the merger to ensure that these efficiencies would filter through to benefit end users of cement."
It said the parties had not satisfied the board that on balance the potential public interest benefits outweighed the anticompetitive effects of the merger.
The minister would in due course decide whether to accept the board's recommendation, it added.
